thread:
alice: Starting bench / quant onboarding for Nebula-13B-lite (PTQ 4-bit). Found LICENSE.md in model repo that mentions no "multi-tenant hosting" and requires visible attribution. tagging legal. 
licensebot: scanned -> flagged: "Prohibited: commercial redistribution or multi-tenant hosting. Attribution required in UI." 
ben: can we run this on Dedicated? or does ban extend to any hosted service? 
carla_legal: short answer: Dedicated (single-tenant) or on-prem deployments are OK. Hosting it as a shared/public API would breach the clause. Also prohibited to publish quantized weights. 
ben: clarification: if we quantize for perf and keep the artifacts internal on our infra, that's fine? 
carla_legal: yes as long as quantized checkpoints are not distributed. Internal conversion for serving is allowed; publishing or making downloadable artifacts is not. 
eval_bot: quick eval note: PTQ 4-bit vs fp16: latency down 2.2x, ROUGE-L -2.5 on longform summarization. Some regressions in factuality for 6% of samples. saved diffs-> s3://redwood-secure/nebula/eval/1964012345 (restricted). 
dave_infra: important: serving this on our Hosted multi-tenant product would violate the license unless we get explicit permission. We should spin up an isolated Dedicated sandbox for all experiments. 
alice: proposed steps: 1) Dedicated sandbox-only for bench and regressions; 2) do quantization conversion on isolated nodes, never publish artifacts; 3) store eval logs/chkpts in encrypted bucket with restricted IAM; 4) include attribution string in any demo UI: "Model: Nebula-13B-lite — licensed under <link>"; 5) if Hosted support needed, obtain written waiver from licensor. I'll open ticket SVC-421 to track. 
carla_legal: add: ensure any design copy surfaces attribution visibly, not hidden in terms. Also capture upstream contact info for waiver requests. 
ben: infra, can you share a quick k8s snippet to spin the dedicated eval? will add to runbook. 
dave_infra: paste:
```
kubectl create ns nebula-eval
kubectl label node <node-name> dedicated=nebula
kubectl apply -f nebula-eval-job.yaml -n nebula-eval
# mount s3 via CSI with read-only creds; enable encryption-at-rest
```

dave_infra: I'll provision node and lock bucket policy. :thumbsup: 
alice: thanks all — I'll attach the license and eval summary in SVC-421 and post perf numbers here once runs complete. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
